clue.text: A point always cut

parts.note: S, south, is a point of the compass
ever means always, as in 'ever hopeful'

explanation.surface: A remark that a sharp point is forever slicing.
explanation.definitionFit: To sever something is to cut it apart or off, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Deposits frozen in banks

parts.note: reads like money held in a bank account that cannot be withdrawn, but the deposits are of snow piled into banks by the wind

explanation.surface: A financial story about savings accounts being frozen.
explanation.definitionFit: Wind-blown snow settles as heaped deposits, banks of white that are literally frozen.

clue.text: .2 State carriage?

definitions.meaning: a light four-wheeled horse-drawn carriage with a folding hood

explanation.surface: A query about a ceremonial state carriage.
explanation.walkthrough: The stray '.2' at the start appears in the clue as held and plays no part in the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: The same name serves both an Australian state and a Victorian style of horse-drawn carriage.

clue.text: To censure or preach dementedly

indicators.note: acting dementedly, as if out of one's mind, so these letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A choice between scolding someone and preaching at them like a madman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dementedly' rearranges the letters of OR PREACH.
explanation.definitionFit: To reproach someone is to rebuke or censure them, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Scratch game

definitions.meaning: to scratch or scrape about with the hands
a board game of building words from lettered tiles

explanation.surface: An impromptu game thrown together from scratch.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means to scratch about frantically and is also the name of a well-known word-building board game.

clue.text: They're often found in a lather

definitions.text: They're often found in a lather

parts.words: They're often found in a lather
parts.note: 'in a lather' suggests people in a state of agitation, but read literally it is soapy foam

explanation.surface: An observation about people who are often worked up.
explanation.definitionFit: Soapy froth bubbles make up a lather, so they are literally found in one.

clue.text: A charming thing to wear

parts.note: 'charming' suggests attractive, but here it means acting as a charm against harm

explanation.surface: Advice about a pretty piece of jewellery to put on.
explanation.definitionFit: A charm worn as protection against evil, usually hung round the neck, is a talisman of this kind.

clue.text: Outlaw about to shout down a primate

indicators.note: the word for outlaw sits about, that is around, the word for shout down

parts.note: to outlaw something is to ban it
to boo a speaker is to shout them down

explanation.surface: A bandit tries to drown out a monkey with his shouting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Outlaw' looks like a noun, a bandit, but it is the verb meaning to prohibit.
explanation.definitionFit: A large African or Arabian monkey with a dog-like muzzle is one species of primate.

clue.text: Time's up! Come out!

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word time is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: taken as written; the 's is a link meaning 'is'

explanation.surface: A prison guard announces that a sentence is over and the inmate may leave.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns TIME backwards. 'Time's up' looks like the end of a period, but it is the instruction.
explanation.definitionFit: To emit is to send forth or give out, as light or sound comes out of a source.

clue.text: Lived in when engaged

definitions.meaning: a house with residents in it is lived in
busy, as a telephone line or a lavatory that is in use

explanation.surface: A house that was inhabited while the couple were betrothed.
explanation.definitionFit: The word describes a home with residents and also a person or line that is busy or taken.

clue.text: Leave no doubt it's a period on strike

parts.note: a spell is a period of time
workers on strike are out

explanation.surface: A union makes it clear that a stoppage is happening.
explanation.definitionFit: To set something out plainly in full is to leave no room for doubt about it.

clue.text: Emotional about Paignton

indicators.note: about here means turned around or rearranged, so the place name's letters are shuffled

explanation.surface: Someone feeling sentimental about a Devon seaside town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' rearranges PAIGNTON. Paignton is a seaside resort in Devon, England.
explanation.definitionFit: Something deeply moving and touching stirs the feelings, so the two words overlap in sense.

clue.text: Unsuccessful student making fresh start at Rugby

definitions.meaning: someone who abandons a course of study before finishing
in rugby, a kick from behind the 22-metre line to restart play

explanation.surface: A struggling pupil gets a second chance at Rugby School.
explanation.walkthrough: Rugby is both a famous English public school and the sport; the second definition is the sport's restart kick.
explanation.definitionFit: The term names a quitter from college and also a restarting kick in rugby football.

clue.text: Aquatic creature softly goes into ground

indicators.note: the letter for softly goes into, that is is placed inside, the word for ground

parts.note: terrain is ground or land
p, piano, is the musical direction for softly

explanation.surface: A water creature quietly burrows into the earth.
explanation.definitionFit: A freshwater turtle of North America is an aquatic reptile.

clue.text: Being in the wrong scene, exit

indicators.note: something done wrong is muddled, so these letters are put in a different order

explanation.surface: An actor leaves the stage in the wrong scene.
explanation.definitionFit: Being, as a noun, means the state of living or having reality.

clue.text: Surrendered to another country

parts.note: reads like a nation capitulating in war, but describes a suspect handed over to a foreign jurisdiction for trial

explanation.surface: A nation gives up and capitulates to its neighbour.
explanation.definitionFit: A fugitive handed over by one state to the legal authorities of another has been sent back under treaty.

clue.text: How one may get down to make money dishonestly?

definitions.text: How one may get down to make money dishonestly?

parts.words: How one may get down to make money dishonestly?
parts.note: 'get down' suggests settling to work, but down is soft plumage used to line a bird's home

explanation.surface: A question about how someone sets about earning money crookedly.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to enrich oneself, often improperly, as a bird lines its home with down.

clue.text: It may be served when bean soup is off

indicators.note: soup that is off has gone bad, a sign that these letters are spoiled and rearranged

explanation.surface: A waiter hesitates to serve a bowl of bean soup that has gone bad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' rearranges BEAN SOUP. 'served' suggests a meal, but legal papers are served on people.
explanation.definitionFit: A writ ordering someone to attend court is formally served on them.

clue.text: Cast a spell with an appearance on stage

definitions.meaning: an actor's coming on to the stage

explanation.surface: A magician bewitches the audience as he walks on.
explanation.walkthrough: The two senses are pronounced differently: en-TRANCE for bewitch, EN-trance for coming on.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a verb meaning to bewitch and a noun for an actor walking on.

clue.text: The point of this device is not always apparent

definitions.text: The point of this device is not always apparent

parts.words: The point of this device is not always apparent
parts.note: suggests a gadget with no obvious purpose, but the device's sharp tip is hidden under a clasp

explanation.surface: A grumble about a gadget whose purpose is unclear.
explanation.definitionFit: A fastener whose sharp tip is tucked under a guard keeps its point covered and out of sight.

clue.text: Switches the films

definitions.meaning: ... a switch, or makes quick light strokes
an informal word for the cinema, as in 'going to the pictures'

explanation.surface: Someone changes the channel between films.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means quick switching movements and is also slang for the cinema.

clue.text: It doubles up with an old master

indicators.note: doubles means the piece is written twice over
in a down clue, up means the word is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A forger's painting is paired with a genuine old master.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' and 'doubles' act together on 'It': in a down clue it reads upwards, then appears twice.
explanation.definitionFit: A Venetian Renaissance painter is one of the great old masters of European art.

clue.text: Got to the point — summed up without a word of hesitation

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the word for summed up goes around the hesitation

parts.note: to have someone taped is to have them summed up or sized up
er is the sound of hesitating in speech

explanation.surface: A speaker made their point succinctly without stammering.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' means outside here, not lacking. 'Got to the point' means narrowed to a tip, not came to the matter at hand.
explanation.definitionFit: A candle or spire that narrows gradually to a sharp tip has come to a point.

clue.text: You get all types in this trade

definitions.text: You get all types in this trade

parts.words: You get all types in this trade
parts.note: suggests a business full of varied people, but types are the letter blocks used to make impressions

explanation.surface: A remark that a certain line of work attracts every kind of person.
explanation.definitionFit: The trade of putting ink on paper from typefaces uses every sort of metal letter.

clue.text: One entitled to look closely

definitions.meaning: a titled noble, such as a lord or duke
to look searchingly or with difficulty

explanation.surface: A nobleman claiming the right to examine something.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a titled member of the nobility and also means to gaze intently.

clue.text: Bond, an agent with sticking power

definitions.meaning: to bond things is to stick them together
an adhesive substance, an agent in the chemical sense

explanation.surface: James Bond is described as a spy with real staying power.
explanation.definitionFit: An adhesive both is a substance that sticks and is used as a verb meaning to join firmly.

clue.text: A romantic tangle

parts.note: suggests a complicated love affair, but means a decorative knot symbolising affection

explanation.surface: A complicated love affair.
explanation.definitionFit: An ornamental interlaced bow given as a token of affection is literally a tangle of love.

clue.text: Produce vibrations and notes are created

indicators.note: created means made anew, so these letters are formed into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A musician produces vibrations and musical notes result.
explanation.definitionFit: To reverberate or vibrate in sympathy with a sound is to produce vibrations.

clue.text: Given such a start, where you should be!

definitions.text: Given such a start, where you should be!

parts.words: Given such a start, where you should be!
parts.note: the start meant is the advantage of a horse's leading body part at the line, which puts the runner in front of the rest

explanation.surface: Encouragement to someone handed an early advantage.
explanation.definitionFit: Having been given a lead of a head, a runner is in front of the field.
